search.snippet: The Zamorak mjolnir is a two handed weapon for members only. There are no skill requirements to wield this item. To obtain one, either complete the enchanted key lore activity, or trade with another player. However, players can only receive one Zamorak mjolnir during the enchanted key lore activity. To obtain one, either complete the Enchanted Key miniquest or trade with another player. As its name implies, the zamorak mjolnir is affiliated with the god Zamorak. It is tipped with Zamorak's symbol of horns. However, it does not provide protection from the zamorakian monsters in the God Wars Dungeon. Mjolnir may refer to: For more information of this category of weapon in general, see polestaff. This page is used to distinguish between articles with similar names. If an internal link led you to this disambiguation page, you may wish to change the link to point directly to the intended article. A Zamorak Mjolnir. There are three mjolnirs to be found: the Saradomin mjolnir, Zamorak mjolnir and Guthix mjolnir. Despite being affiliated with the gods, they do not provide protection from their related factions in the God Wars Dungeon. search.snippet: Desert shirts are suitable for desert environments, like the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. When worn, this clothing item delays the desert heat effect by 12 additional seconds. It has no other bonuses.
search.title: Desert shirt - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Desert clothing is needed for the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. When worn, they decrease the desert heat effect. It has no bonuses. A full set of desert robes is needed during The Tourist Trap quest, where they are given to a slave miner in exchange for a set of slave robes.

search.snippet: During the Shadow of the Storm quest, the desert shirt and robe can be dyed using black dye. Note that the black desert shirt and black desert robe do not offer protection from the desert heat.
search.title: Desert clothing - OSRS Wiki

search.snippet: Desert clothing is used to protect against desert heat when travelling in the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. When worn, they decrease the desert heat effect (+12 seconds between drinks). It has no bonuses. A full set of white desert robe outfit is needed for the Tourist Trap quest. A cool, light desert shirt. Desert clothing is needed for the Kharidian Desert south of Shantay Pass. When worn, they decrease the desert heat effect. It has no bonuses. The shirt is also needed for the quest Shadow of the Storm. In the quest, the shirt becomes a black desert shirt when it is dyed using black mushroom ink. Desert clothing is a set of white clothing which can be bought from Shantay in the Shantay Pass or Ali Morrisane for a reasonably low price. When worn, desert clothing decreases the desert heat effect of the Kharidian Desert. Desert clothing has no Defence or Attack bonuses.
